answer.rationale: The incumbent has refused repricing despite an 18% spend-cut mandate, while the archived record indicates the low-cost vendor delivered sharp unit-cost reductions and rapid onboarding. However, the record does not establish delivery performance under a 94%-loaded line or confirm capacity for full primary conversion. Verify that record before committing; limit any switch to a guarded, capacity-validated transition rather than assuming prior cost and invoicing results prove continuity risk is acceptable.
